description.value: Ignite Pizzeria is a Vancouver-grown stone-fired pizza chain founded in 2017, with the Yaletown outpost operating as a licensed restaurant with a south-facing patio in the heart of the neighbourhood. Pizzas are hand-tossed and fired at 800°F from low-sodium dough that rests for three days, spanning carnivore, herbivore, vegan, and gluten-friendly builds. The accessible, community-focused space with indoor and outdoor seating makes it a practical and satisfying refueling stop for cyclists passing through Yaletown.
